name: std::span<T,Extent>::front
intro:
Returns a reference to the first element in the span.

Calling front on an empty span results in undefined behavior.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the first element.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: For a span c, the expression c.front() is equivalent to *c.begin().

summary: Returns a reference to the first element in the span.
